static_findings.title: Gate Verdicts Dict Incomplete (Missing 'debate' & 'cluster' Keys)
static_findings.evidence: Spec line 60 mandates 'every gate above must produce an explicit per-call verdict in the sizing table — even when the verdict is "no-op."' AAPL, MU, MRVL, ASML are missing 'debate' key in gate_verdicts dict despite decision.json including debate_residual_confidence blocks (0.55–0.75 range). Gate verdict text mentions 'debate -1' but is buried in event_risk verdict, not isolated to debate gate key. MSFT and SMCI missing multiple gates (cluster, event_risk, fundamentals, sector, vrp). Spec line 60: 'absence of a verdict reads as "didn't check."' These calls lack explicit debate verdicts. Compliance: 5/6 calls have incomplete gate_verdicts dicts. Incident: prior audit flagged 37.5% VRP compliance; this audit shows structural compliance failure across debate verdicts.

static_findings.title: VRP Gate Explicit Verdicts — 4/6 Calls Compliant
static_findings.evidence: Spec line 60 emphasizes VRP gate had 37.5% compliance in prior audit and requires explicit verdict every time, including no-op. Decision.json: AAPL, MU, MRVL, ASML show 'no-op' or explicit (67% pass rate). MSFT and SMCI lack VRP verdicts entirely (missing from gate_verdicts dict). Improvement from 37.5% → 67%, but 2 of 6 calls still lack explicit VRP. Spec line 16-17: VRP sign gate (long-vol up in negative-VRP, short-vol up in positive-VRP). Verdict text for AAPL is exemplary ('no-op (FAIR/neutral, directional)'); others are terse. Recommendation: standardize VRP verdicts to always include (a) VRP classification, (b) signal type (long-vol / short-vol / directional), (c) no-op or fire rationale.

static_findings.title: Soft-Cluster (0.664) Correctly Not Penalized; Mechanical Gate Working
static_findings.evidence: Spec lines 19-27 set mechanical thresholds: ≥0.70 = cluster (penalty), 0.60–0.70 = soft-watch (no penalty), <0.60 = no flag. uw risk portfolio-correlation returned MRVL/ASML=0.664. Decision.json correctly applied no -1 tier and surfaced as 'soft-watch — monitor'. MU/ASML=0.566 below threshold, no flag. Mechanical threshold enforcement is CORRECT and has removed prior discretionary variance. **POSITIVE FINDING: this gate is working as designed.**

static_findings.title: Watchlist Write-Back Top-5 Correct, Properly Excluding VETO
static_findings.evidence: Spec line 264: persist top-5 post-gate, excluding VETO'd. Decision.json top-5 by raw_score: AAPL(6), MU(5), MRVL(4), ASML(4) — MSFT VETO'd. Persisted to watchlist_write_back: [AAPL, MU, MRVL, ASML]. Confirmed in ~/.config/unusual-whales-pp-cli/watchlist.json conviction_2026-06-11 group: [AAPL, MU, MRVL, ASML]. **PASS: watchlist write-back is mechanically correct and follows spec gate-and-persist rule.**

static_findings.title: Sector Rotation Gate — Verdicts Ambiguous (No Named Persistence Score)
static_findings.evidence: Spec lines 28, 50: apply −1 tier if sector rotation flowing out with persistence_score ≥ 0.6 (≥3-of-5-days, per 2026-05-25 fix note). Decision.json shows verdicts like 'no-op (semis de-risk surfaced)' or 'no-op (Tech INFLOW persist 1.0; semis de-risk surfaced)' but NO named persistence_score ≥ 0.6 adverse rotation on any individual call. Either (a) no sector rotation adverse enough to fire, or (b) sector gate was checked but verdict text is informational rather than mechanical. Verdict text for AAPL mentions 'Tech INFLOW persist 1.0' (positive), so no fire. MRVL/ASML semis context noted but no ≥0.6 decay cited. **Verdict: sector gate appears to have checked (context present) but did not fire on any call due to lack of ≥0.6 adverse score. Compliance acceptable but verdicts could be more explicit about the persistence threshold check.**

static_findings.title: VETO Override Mechanic — Cluster/Event-Risk Gates Skipped on MSFT
static_findings.evidence: MSFT is VETO'd (fundamentals verdict), final_size='watch_only'. Gate verdicts dict shows only 4/8 gates (regime, panic, fundamentals, event_risk). Spec does not explicitly state whether VETO'd calls are exempt from correlation (cluster) and other checks, or whether those gates should still be evaluated and marked 'n/a (VETO'd)'. Per spec intent (risk officer gate all, then VETO overrides all), cluster gate SHOULD have been run on MSFT to understand portfolio risk, even though VETO overrides sizing. Current implementation skips it. Recommended: run all 8 gates even on VETO'd calls, mark skipped ones as 'n/a (overridden by VETO)' rather than omitting from dict.

static_findings.title: FOMC T+4 Mislabeling Inconsistent with Spec — Trading Day Count Issue
static_findings.evidence: Spec line 35 defines firing condition as '≤T+3' (and stacking to −1 when two or more named events fall in-window). Decision.json labels FOMC as 'T+3' when actual trading-day count is T+4 (six calendar days with weekend gap). This is a systematic miscalculation affecting all swing candidates simultaneously. The agent either (a) counted calendar days instead of trading days, or (b) used a different T+0 anchor (e.g., next trading session vs report date). Per spec 2026-06-06 audit Phase 6 (lines 39): the gate's 0.43 WR compliance shows 'exactly the ungated win-rate (43% vs 43%)' — the widened P1.4 window had zero discrimination. This T+4 misfire is an edge-case of that windowing problem. **Recommendation: explicitly code trading-day calculation and gate only on T+0=report_date, T+1=next_session, T+2/T+3/T+4 as live thresholds; any event ≥T+4 is outside firing range unless holding through it.**

vol-surface-scout.job_clarity: Agent scans the vol surface for term-structure dislocations — specifically KINKED/BACKWARDATION names, single-contract IV outliers, and back-month skew mispricings — to feed the daily conviction rubric with non-directional vol trade candidates. Agent has ONE scored rubric line: "+1 in vol-surface-scout KINKED or BACKWARDATION watch with VRP-aligned bias" (daily-analysis.md, line 307). No directional sizing; the +1 is gated to: (1) VRP alignment (do not surface SELL VOL in negative-VRP environment; do not surface BUY VOL in positive-VRP), and (2) valid term-structure classifier from uw options-structure iv-term-structure. Agent owns KINKED-at-earnings handoff to earnings-scout and BACKWARDATION calendar identification (mutually-exclusive routing via signal-confluence-quant.md C13). Lottery/expensive-skew composite is advisory-only (0 rubric points; withheld per signal-confluence-quant.md line 149).
tool_wiring: uw options-structure iv-term-structure: EXISTS (verified --help output: average IV by expiry, returns BACKWARDATION/CONTANGO/KINKED classifier) — flags (none custom; standard --date, --symbol, --json, --quiet, --select, --compact). Tool **returns per-ticker result**, agent must iterate watchlist or passed-in elevated-IV names.

uw options-structure term-skew: EXISTS (verified --help: 25Δ put/call IV skew at target DTE) — flags --dte-target (default 365), --symbol (required), --json, --quiet. **Required flag: --symbol** means per-ticker calls; agent must loop the watchlist.

uw historical iv-percentile-zscore: EXISTS (verified --help: IV30d percentile + z-score over trailing window, default 252d Goyal-Saretto outlier-robust) — flags --lookback-days (default 252), --symbol (required), --json, --quiet. **Mandatory per agent line 10** — PRIMARY percentile read, agent must prefer this over raw IV rank.

uw screener iv-rank: EXISTS (verified --help: extreme IV rank high/low by mode, --top-n, --mode, --min-marketcap, --date, --json, --quiet) — agent uses for 'sanity check, not signal' (line 11). Tool is watchlist-less (GICS aggregate); returns top-N by mode.

uw historical vrp: EXISTS (verified --help: IV30d − realised σ, symbol required, --realised-window-days default 30, --json, --quiet) — **mandatory gating tool** (agent line 12): agent reads VRP sign from Step 0 context (passed pre-computed), but MUST state VRP classification per candidate output (positive/negative/neutral). Directional-bias gate: positive VRP → favour SELL VOL; negative → favour BUY VOL.

uw options-structure front-end-iv-ratio: EXISTS (verified --help: single-number classifier >1.05 BACKWARDATION, <0.95 CONTANGO, near-DTE vs far-DTE ratio) — flags --near-dte (default 1), --far-dte (default 30), --symbol (required), --json, --quiet. **Panic discriminator** (agent line 13): ratio > 1.10 + rising = event still pending (do not fade); ratio falling = panic resolving (calendar opportunity).

uw options-flow iv-outliers: EXISTS (verified --help: single-contract IV blowups, --symbol optional, --min-iv default 1.0, --min-volume default 50, --top-n default 20, --json, --quiet) — agent surfaces whale hedges / mispricings (agent line 14). Per-name or watchlist-wide call.

uw screener earnings-catalyst: EXISTS (verified --help: upcoming earnings + elevated IV in next N days, --days-until-earnings default 14, --min-iv-rank default 50, --json, --quiet) — **kink-vs-earnings alignment check** (agent line 8, 15). Agent matches kink_expiry against earnings date; if aligned → hand off to earnings-scout with +1 award in signal-confluence-quant.
gates_assessment: VRP-aligned bias gate (line 12): **CITED but NOT VALIDATED in agent prose.** Agent states 'State the VRP sign and bias for every output' but does not specify the gate mechanics — does 'aligned' mean: (a) short-vol bias only when VRP positive? (b) short-vol AND long-vol are both valid, but sizing flips? (c) KINKED-at-earnings overrides VRP sign (earnings are event-driven, not premium)? Agent prose is vague; signal-confluence-quant.md C6 confirms the gate exists (Lottery fade withheld in UPTREND, routed via C13) but does NOT explicitly gate vol-surface-scout's output. RECOMMENDED: clarify gate in agent line 12 — proposed rule: 'Award the +1 only when VRP sign aligns (positive VRP for SELL VOL structures; negative VRP for BUY VOL / calendar); KINKED-at-earnings overrides this (event-driven). State gate result per candidate.'

Panic-threshold gate (line 13): **CITED AND DERIVABLE.** front-end-iv-ratio > 1.05 = panic (explicit); > 1.10 + rising = event-still-pending (explicitly excludes calendar play). Gate is deterministic on tool output.

Kink-vs-earnings alignment gate (line 8, 15): **CITED AND DERIVABLE.** uw screener earnings-catalyst supplies dates; agent matches kink_expiry from uw options-structure iv-term-structure. When aligned → hand off to earnings-scout (routing via C13); when KINKED but no catalyst → clean calendar play. Gate is explicit but enforcement point is in signal-confluence-quant (routing), not agent itself.

Liquidity floor (daily-analysis.md line 79, C12): **APPLICABLE BUT NOT MENTIONED IN AGENT.** Daily-analysis Step 0 enforces price ≥ $5 AND 20-day dollar-ADV ≥ $50M before handing candidates to Phase 1 agents. Agent receives pre-floored set; if agent iterates watchlist directly (a risk), it must re-apply the floor. Agent does not cite this gate → potential leakage if watchlist contains sub-floor names.

Lottery composite advisory gate (line 37, C6): **WITHHELD / advisory-only.** Agent mentions 'You may surface a lottery_score composite' but does NOT award the −2 fade line (withheld in UPTREND regime per signal-confluence-quant line 149). Any lottery output must route through C13 router so it does not stack with −2 overcrowded-long line. Agent does not cite this routing explicitly.
vol-surface-scout.scope_discipline: Agent is scoped to vol-surface dislocations only — **term structure shape, single-contract IV outliers, skew, and calendars.** Agent is **NOT a directional trader** and does NOT own: (1) gamma setups (γ-flip-tracker owns 0DTE GEX; dealer-positioning-strategist owns swing-horizon DEX/vanna); (2) earnings directional calls (earnings-scout owns BUY/SELL VOL verdict on upcoming prints; vol-surface only surfaces KINKED-at-earnings as a signal, with earnings-scout final call); (3) OI build / dark-pool flow (accumulation-hunter owns those). **Boundary fence with multileg-strategist (C13)**: when a calendar spread is flagged by both agents, **multileg owns the points** (multileg saw the actual coordinated flow structure; vol-surface is context). When KINKED-at-earnings is detected by both earnings-scout and vol-surface, **earnings-scout owns earnings_vol rubric line**; vol-surface flags the structure but does not separately score. Agent does cite the routing: line 8 'hand off to earnings-scout' and output surface specifies 'KINKED with catalyst alignment (event-driven, sized for the move; hand off to earnings-scout)'. **No scope creep observed** — agent stays on vol-surface shape; routing is explicit.
vol-surface-scout.scored_advisory_honesty: Agent distinguishes scored vs advisory correctly: **scored lane is the +1 KINKED/BACKWARDATION line (non-directional, gated by VRP + term structure validity)**. **Advisory lanes explicitly marked as such:** (1) 'Lottery/expensive-skew composite (2026-05-25 register C6) — ADVISORY prose only, 0 rubric points (line WITHHELD)' (line 37); (2) 'VRP-magnitude + term-slope scalers (2026-05-25 register C5/C9) — ADVISORY' (line 39). Agent does NOT claim edge on skew direction (Boyer & Vorkink noted; correctly cites paper and sign fix 2026-05-30); does NOT claim predictive power on ZGL (just surface the shape). No over-claiming observed. **Caveat:** agent line 39 states 'the single-name VRP **percentile/tercile** (C5) and the term-structure **slope tercile** (C9)' are advisory until `/calibration-audit` validates (n ≥ 30 accrued obs). Agent does NOT live-size on these — correctly withholds. However, agent line 39 states 'one `uw historical vrp` snapshot per date today' which assumes daily snapshots are being accumulated; the repo's current data model (2026-06-11 EOD) may not have 30 accumulated snapshots yet. **Status:** advisory lane is correctly gated; live-status depends on `/calibration-audit` checkpoint.
vol-surface-scout.write_rule_present: **NO FILE WRITES OR WATCHLIST MUTATIONS CITED IN AGENT.** Agent is read-only: it reads uw CLI data, surfaces candidates, and emits prose output. It does NOT call `uw watchlist manage --action add/remove` (that is risk-monitor's job in daily-analysis Step 2d, line 264). It does NOT emit any decision.json or envelope (that is signal-confluence-quant's job). It does NOT modify any files or state. **Risk:** agent may be invoked by the daily-analysis orchestrator, which does call `uw watchlist manage` (line 264) on the Phase 1 candidate union **including** vol-surface-scout's output. The agent itself is safe; the orchestrator is responsible for the write. No prior incident of vol-surface-scout writing unprompted.
live_test_protocol: PHASE A — Tool-existence verification (read-only probes). (1) Confirm uw options-structure iv-term-structure --help returns both KINKED and BACKWARDATION as valid classifiers; (2) Confirm uw historical iv-percentile-zscore --help returns percentile + zscore fields (not just IV rank); (3) Confirm uw options-structure front-end-iv-ratio --help returns a numeric ratio and ratio classification logic.

PHASE B — Term-structure classifier audit (spot-check on 2026-06-11 EOD data — today). B1. Run `uw options-structure iv-term-structure --symbol SPY --date 2026-06-11 --json --quiet` and verify output schema includes: {ticker, structure: 'BACKWARDATION'|'CONTANGO'|'KINKED', kink_expiry (if KINKED), [expiry, iv] pairs by DTE}. B2. Iterate 3–5 names from today's vol-rank extremes (uw screener iv-rank --mode high --top-n 5): run iv-term-structure on each. Confirm at least one KINKED or BACKWARDATION result emerges from the extreme-IV cohort (edge case: if all are CONTANGO, vol-surface has low signal today). B3. For a BACKWARDATION-classified ticker, cross-check with uw options-structure front-end-iv-ratio on the same date: confirm ratio > 1.05. (Validation: if iv-term-structure says BACKWARDATION, front-end-iv-ratio must agree; if they diverge, uw CLI has a bug or the ticker's expiry structure is ambiguous.)

PHASE C — Percentile-vs-raw-IV-rank alignment (Goyal-Saretto robustness check). C1. Pick one KINKED or BACKWARDATION name from Phase B. Run `uw historical iv-percentile-zscore --symbol <T> --lookback-days 252 --json --quiet` and capture: {percentile, zscore}. C2. Run `uw screener iv-rank --top-n 100 --mode high --json --quiet` and check where the Phase-B name ranks. Compare: (a) if percentile is ≥85 and iv-rank is top-20 → good alignment (both identify as extreme); (b) if percentile is ≥85 but iv-rank is top-50 → percentile is catching an outlier rank misses (agent should prefer percentile per line 10); (c) if percentile < 70 and iv-rank is top-20 → single-day IV spike (raw rank corrupted, percentile robust — agent call is correct). C3. Validate: agent line 10 states 'without Goyal-Saretto percentile, calls are weak.' Check whether the Phase-B name's win-rate (per signal-confluence-quant backtest) differs when scored on raw iv-rank vs iv-percentile-zscore. If win-rate increases when using percentile, percentile justifies the mandate.

PHASE D — VRP classification and bias assignment (mandatory gate validation). D1. Run `uw historical vrp --symbol SPY --date 2026-06-11 --json --quiet` and capture: {iv30, realised_sigma_30, vrp (iv30 − σ30), classification (positive/negative/neutral), bias_recommendation}. D2. For a BACKWARDATION SELL-VOL candidate from Phase B: confirm agent output includes `vrp_classification: 'positive'` (vol expensive vs realised). If VRP is negative (vol cheap), agent should either (a) not surface the SELL VOL candidate, or (b) surface with explicit caveat 'VRP-conflict: negative VRP, short-vol not recommended'. Check agent text for this gate. D3. For a KINKED-at-earnings candidate (from Phase B + Phase A B2): confirm agent output includes `catalyst: <earnings_date>` and tags the candidate as 'event-driven, sized for the move; hand off to earnings-scout' (per line 28). If VRP is positive (vol expensive) AND earnings event is pending, agent should still recommend the structure (KINKED earnings override VRP sign). Validate agent does NOT veto earnings-KINKED candidates based on VRP sign alone.

PHASE E — Panic-threshold gate on BACKWARDATION (front-end-iv-ratio discrimination). E1. Pick a BACKWARDATION ticker from Phase B. Run `uw options-structure front-end-iv-ratio --symbol <T> --near-dte 1 --far-dte 30 --date 2026-06-11 --json --quiet` and capture: {ratio, classification}. E2. If ratio > 1.10 AND it is **rising day-over-day** (requires prior-day call too): agent should flag 'event still pending, do not fade' per line 34. Confirm agent does NOT surface this name as a calendar-spread candidate. E3. If ratio > 1.05 but ≤ 1.10 AND it is **falling** (or flat): agent should surface as calendar candidate per line 29. Confirm agent text includes 'panic resolving' logic.

PHASE F — Single-contract IV outliers (whale-hedge detection). F1. Run `uw options-flow iv-outliers --symbol SPY --min-iv 1.5 --min-volume 50 --json --quiet` and capture top-3 results: {ticker, strike, expiry, iv, volume}. F2. For each outlier, run `uw historical iv-percentile-zscore --symbol <T> --lookback-days 252 --json --quiet` to check if the outlier's IV is ≥2σ above percentile (whale hedge misprice). Confirm agent surfaces extreme-IV single contracts in prose (line 30: 'Single-contract iv-outliers (potential whale-hedge mispricings)').

PHASE G — Earnings alignment and routing (C13 mutual exclusivity gate). G1. Run `uw screener earnings-catalyst --days-until-earnings 14 --min-iv-rank 50 --json --quiet` and get 3–5 candidates with pending earnings in the next 14 days. G2. For each earnings candidate, run `uw options-structure iv-term-structure --symbol <T> --json --quiet` and check structure: (a) if KINKED and kink_expiry matches earnings date → agent should flag 'KINKED with catalyst alignment (event-driven, sized for the move; hand off to earnings-scout)' and award **signal-confluence-quant +1 vol-surface line, but NOT also score earnings-scout's earnings_vol line** (C13 routing: earnings-scout owns it). Validate the agent output includes handoff language; (b) if KINKED but NO earnings date match → clean calendar play if front-end-iv-ratio is falling.

PHASE H — Liquidity floor enforcement (C12 upstream gate check). H1. Check whether the Phase 0 Step 0 context (passed to agent via daily-analysis orchestrator) includes a pre-floored candidate list. If so, agent receives already-filtered names and does not need to re-check. If agent is invoked standalone (outside daily-analysis pipeline), confirm agent applies C12 floor: price ≥ $5 AND 20-day dollar-ADV ≥ $50M before output.

PHASE I — Output schema and mandatory fields validation (per agent line 17–25). I1. Run a live daily-analysis report (post-market, 2026-06-11 or later) and inspect vol-surface-scout's output block in the JSON envelope. Confirm every candidate includes: ticker, structure (KINKED/BACKWARDATION/CONTANGO), kink_expiry (if applicable), iv_percentile_zscore (with percentile + zscore fields), iv_rank (raw, sanity check), vrp_classification (positive/negative/neutral), front_end_iv_ratio + panic_call, catalyst (earnings date or 'no catalyst'), bias (BUY VOL / SELL VOL / CALENDAR), trade (specific structure, strikes, expiries), invalidation (explicit kill condition). I2. Check the three output buckets (line 27–30): (a) KINKED-with-catalyst bucket populated? (b) BACKWARDATION-with-no-catalyst bucket has front-end-iv-ratio falling? (c) Single-contract outliers tagged with whale signature?

PHASE J — Win-rate validation and scoring confirmation (signal-confluence-quant integration check). J1. In the decision.json envelope (daily-analysis Step 2d output), find every vol-surface-scout-flagged candidate and confirm signal-confluence-quant assigned it a score_component: `{rubric_line: '+1 in vol-surface-scout KINKED or BACKWARDATION watch with VRP-aligned bias', points: 1, source_agent: 'vol-surface-scout', source_tool: 'uw options-structure iv-term-structure', evidence: '<VRP classification + structure + reason>'}`. If a vol-surface-scout candidate received +1, confirm: (a) VRP alignment is stated in evidence (positive VRP for SELL VOL / calendar; negative VRP for BUY VOL or earnings-event override); (b) structure (KINKED/BACKWARDATION/CONTANGO) matches the tool output; (c) no double-scoring via multileg or earnings-scout (C13 mutual-exclusivity gate enforced). J2. Check win-rate on vol-surface-scout signal class across recent runs (last 10 daily reports, if available in `/calibration-audit` checkpoints): is vol_realisation_rate ≥ 0.50? If < 0.50, signal is not edge and sizing should cap at 'starter' (per signal-confluence-quant sizing-map line 37–41).

EDGE CASE — VRP-KINKED earnings override logic verification. V1. Create a test case: ticker has KINKED structure at an upcoming earnings date. Run on two different VRP regimes: (a) positive VRP (vol expensive, short-vol favored), (b) negative VRP (vol cheap, long-vol favored). In case (a), agent should recommend SELL VOL on the KINKED earnings (event premium, not term-structure premium). In case (b), agent should recommend BUY VOL or stand aside (event risk + cheap vol = no edge). Validate agent text handles both scenarios.

static_findings.title: Agent does not explicitly clarify VRP-aligned-bias gate mechanics
static_findings.evidence: Line 12 states 'State the VRP sign and bias for every output' and 'Positive VRP (vol expensive vs realised) → favour SELL VOL / iron condors. Negative VRP (vol cheap vs realised) → favour BUY VOL / calendars.' However, the agent does NOT specify: (1) Does KINKED-at-earnings override VRP sign (is it event-driven, so VRP-agnostic)? (2) Are BACKWARDATION calendars gated on VRP, or only on front-end-iv-ratio falling? (3) What is the exact rule: 'surface the trade but note the conflict,' or 'do not surface if VRP opposes'? Signal-confluence-quant.md C6 references vol-surface in the lottery context but does NOT detail the vol-surface-scout's own VRP gate. Recommended: expand agent line 12 to clarify: 'Award +1 and surface the structure ONLY when VRP sign aligns (positive VRP for short-vol / SELL VOL / iron condors / calendars; negative VRP for long-vol / BUY VOL). EXCEPTION: KINKED-at-earnings is event-driven and overrides VRP sign (hand off to earnings-scout for directional verdict). For BACKWARDATION calendars (front-end-iv-ratio falling), VRP is the primary gate: surface only when VRP is positive (panic resolving in expensive-vol regime).'

static_findings.title: Agent mandates uw historical iv-percentile-zscore as PRIMARY but daily-analysis does not explicitly pass it from Step 0
static_findings.evidence: Agent line 10 states 'PRIMARY percentile read' and 'without VRP, you can answer...but not 'is this dislocation rich or cheap?' without VRP.' Daily-analysis Step 0 fetches `uw historical vrp` once (step 4 macro layer) and passes it to all agents. However, there is NO explicit `uw historical iv-percentile-zscore` pre-fetch in Step 0. If agent is invoked standalone (not via daily-analysis pipeline), it must call this tool for every candidate. If via pipeline, agent receives Step 0 context but must re-fetch per-ticker (the tool is per-symbol, not a single market call). This is not a bug (agent correctly cites the tool as required), but the daily-analysis pipeline Step 0 could benefit from pre-fetching the top-20 high-IV candidates' percentiles to save agent tokens. **No mandate violation** — agent is correct to call the tool per candidate; risk is token burn only.

static_findings.title: Agent lottery composite advisory lane is withheld but agent line 37 does not cite the register gate
static_findings.evidence: Agent line 37 introduces 'Lottery / expensive-skew composite (2026-05-25 register C6)' and explains Boyer & Vorkink (2014) result and the sign fix (2026-05-30). Agent then states 'You MAY surface a lottery_score composite — high IV-rank ∧ call-rich skew ∧ crowded call-buying z-score — as advisory color. DO NOT emit a scored −2 fade line.' However, agent does not cite the **gate condition: UPTREND regime is live, so the −2 line is withheld**. Agent line 37 says 'Do NOT emit a scored −2 fade line' but does NOT say **why** (regime gated). Signal-confluence-quant.md line 149 clarifies: 'Gated to **non-UPTREND regimes only** (the current regime is UPTREND).' Recommended: add to agent line 37: '(Withheld in UPTREND regime; awaiting non-UPTREND window per 2026-05-30 C6 gate. In current UPTREND, surface as advisory prose only, routed through C13 router so it does not stack with −2 overcrowded-long.)'.

static_findings.title: Agent line 39 references VRP-magnitude scalers (C5/C9) but does not state calibration status or n-requirement
static_findings.evidence: Line 39 states 'VRP-magnitude + term-slope scalers (2026-05-25 register C5/C9) — ADVISORY... it becomes a live size multiplier (and replaces the binary panic gate) only when `/calibration-audit` finds premium-selling WR monotone across VRP/slope terciles on n ≥ 30 accrued obs. The per-name percentile series must accrue first (one `uw historical vrp` snapshot per date today).' Agent correctly gates this as advisory, but does NOT state: (1) current status of n (how many snapshots have accrued as of 2026-06-12?), (2) whether the `/calibration-audit` has validated the monotonicity, (3) fallback rule if n < 30 (use binary gate, which is what currently applies). Recommended: add 'Current status: C5/C9 advisory pending n ≥ 30 realised snapshots (current: <n if known> as of 2026-06-12); binary front-end-iv-ratio panic gate is live. Check `/calibration-audit` for C5/C9 validation status.'

static_findings.title: Agent does not cite liquidity floor (C12) as an upstream gate, risk of sub-floor names leaking if agent iterates watchlist directly
static_findings.evidence: Daily-analysis Step 0 line 79 mandates C12 liquidity floor: 'price ≥ $5 AND 20-day dollar-ADV ≥ $50M (or notional-equivalent). Fail closed: a name whose liquidity cannot be verified is dropped.' Agent does not mention this gate. If agent is invoked via daily-analysis orchestrator, Step 0 pre-filters the candidate set and agent receives a floored funnel. If agent is invoked standalone (e.g. per-ticker deep-dive on a micro-cap), agent has no floor enforcement and could surface illiquid names. Recommended: add to agent line 1 introduction: 'Assume candidates passed to this agent have cleared the upstream C12 liquidity floor (price ≥ $5 AND 20-day dollar-ADV ≥ $50M) when invoked via the daily-analysis pipeline. If invoked standalone, apply C12 before screening via iv-percentile-zscore.'

static_findings.title: Agent output spec does not include 'kink_expiry' for CONTANGO structures (edge case)
static_findings.evidence: Agent line 18 output spec states: 'ticker, structure (KINKED / BACKWARDATION / CONTANGO), kink_expiry if applicable.' The phrase 'if applicable' correctly implies kink_expiry is only for KINKED. However, the spec does not say what the term-structure context is for a CONTANGO name: is it 'clean front-to-back slope' (no calendar opportunity), 'vol collapse expected' (premium-buying candidate), or just a baseline for comparison? Recommended: expand line 18 to clarify CONTANGO meaning: 'kink_expiry (if KINKED; null for BACKWARDATION and CONTANGO)' and add to line 26 (invalidation): 'explicitly (kink dissipates → CONTANGO or BACKWARDATION), backwardation persists past next session → event-driven not mispriced, VRP flips sign, IV expands through trigger [for short-vol], term structure flattens away from KINKED [for calendars])'

static_findings.title: Agent references 'uw insights signal-confluence' as a supporting tool (agent line 15, signal-confluence-quant) but does not cite it in its own 8-tool list
static_findings.evidence: Agent line 15 states 'earnings-catalyst — match kink_expiry against earnings dates. Kink at earnings = the play (hand off to earnings-scout for the verdict)' — no tool cited. Agent's list is: 1. iv-term-structure, 2. term-skew, 3. iv-percentile-zscore, 4. iv-rank, 5. vrp, 6. front-end-iv-ratio, 7. iv-outliers, 8. earnings-catalyst. Agent does NOT cite `uw insights signal-confluence` (which is used by signal-confluence-quant to confirm the candidate, and now earns +2 in the rubric per 2026-05-23 P1.2). Recommended: agent does not need to call signal-confluence (that is quant's job), so no tool-wiring issue. But the agent-description (line 3) should clarify: 'Scans the vol surface for term-structure dislocations... [signal-confluence confirmation is applied downstream by signal-confluence-quant, not by this agent]' to avoid confusion.

multileg-strategist.job_clarity: Decode institutional multi-leg flow structure (verticals, calendars, flies, condors, ratios) from coordinated options activity and infer directional thesis with built-in risk caps. Spawn as Phase 1 agent in `/daily-analysis` and `/weekly-analysis` fleet to surface structured flow plays (scored +2 when directional and term-structure-anchored). Mandate: per-ticker structure inference + term-structure context + play-type classification + evidence + thesis + invalidation condition. Output feeds signal-confluence-quant's rubric scoring (+2 points for term-structure-anchored directional multileg) and daily/weekly report §3/§7 prose.
tool_wiring: uw hot-chains multileg --help: EXISTS. Returns option_symbol (contract-level, not ticker), multileg_ratio, multileg_total/volume, premium, IV. Returns CONTRACTS aggregated globally with no per-ticker parsing — the agent MUST parse option_symbol (e.g. 'SPY260618P00720000') to extract ticker, strike, expiry, option_type. Flags: --min-multileg-ratio (default 0.3), --top-n (default 20), --date, --json --quiet standard.

uw options-flow top-premium-trades --help: EXISTS. Filters by --symbol, --option-type (call|put), --sector, --top-n. Returns {delta, executed_at, expiry, implied_volatility, option_type, premium, price, side, size, strike, underlying_price, underlying_symbol}. Multileg-strategist spec requires filtering to ≥$1M premium — no flag in CLI, agent must filter post-fetch. Returns largest single-trade options by dollar premium (intended for single-legs); multileg-strategist consumes it to **ratio large single-legs vs multi-leg mean** (spec line 11) — this is an *comparative analysis*, not tool-native multileg parsing.

uw options-flow greek-screener --help: EXISTS. Flags: --symbol, --min/max-delta, --min-gamma, --min-vega, --sort-by (premium|delta|gamma|vega), --top-n. Returns per-contract {delta, gamma, vega, theta, premium, strike, expiry, option_type, side, size, …}. Agent spec: 'delta skew across strikes confirms structure' — but tool returns individual contracts, not strike-level aggregates. Agent must manually group by underlying and strike to compute delta ranges / skew profiles (vertical = narrow delta range, fly = delta-neutral, ratio = asymmetric). **No native delta-skew aggregation.**

uw options-flow expiry-heatmap --help: EXISTS. Flags: --symbol, --top-n, --date. Returns {expiry, total, total_premium_call, total_premium_put, total_volume_call, total_volume_put} — PER-EXPIRY aggregates, not strike-level. Multileg spec: 'same expiry across two strikes = vertical; different expiries = calendar/diagonal' — tool returns premium/volume BY EXPIRY, not by STRIKE. Agent must cross-reference with greek-screener or expiry-heatmap strikes (not returned by heatmap) to confirm vertical (same expiry, two distinct active strikes) vs calendar (two expiries, aligned strikes). **Heatmap lacks strike dimension — structure inference requires manual re-aggregation from greek-screener or raw multileg contracts.**

uw options-structure iv-term-structure --help: EXISTS. Flags: --symbol, --date, --json --quiet. Returns {classification (BACKWARDATION|CONTANGO|KINKED), term_structure_context_details}. Multileg spec line 6: 'calendar against KINKED at back-month = event; against CONTANGO = vol-mispricing' — tool returns classification per-underlying but does NOT distinguish *which expiry is KINKED* or provide back-month-specific IV levels. Agent must infer from classification + manual comparison of front vs back IV (not returned by this tool). **Tool returns structural label, not expiry-specific kink position.**

uw options-structure gex --help: EXISTS. Flags: --symbol, --dte-max (default 45), --date. Returns {per_strike: [{strike, net_gex}], zero_gamma_level, regime, total_gex}. Spec line 7: 'locate where in the chain the spread sits (near zero-gamma vs deep wing)' — tool provides strike-level GEX and ZGL, which map spread location relative to gamma. **Wiring valid here.**
gates_assessment: multileg_ratio > 0.3 threshold (spec line 8, daily-analysis): Cited as primary screen entry gate, sourced from `uw hot-chains multileg --min-multileg-ratio` flag output. Rationale provided in multileg-strategist.md line 8: '>0.3 find tickers with multileg_ratio'. Derivable? YES — CLI returns multileg_ratio per contract; agent filters on this field. **Rationale CITED (entry criterion).**

repeat_count ≥ 2 for HIGH-conviction (spec multileg-strategist.md line 16, weekly-only mandate): Requires 'identical strike/expiry combinations recurring on ≥2 trading days' over trailing week. Rationale: 'materially higher directional weight than single-day prints.' Derivable? REQUIRES AGENT TO MANUALLY TRACK multi-day state — CLI has no `--repeat_count` or `--lookback-days` flag. Agent must compare today's multileg contracts against prior N trading days' uw hot-chains multileg outputs (cached or re-queried). **Rationale CITED but GATE REQUIRES EXTERNAL STATE TRACKING (not tool-native).** The daily skill sets repeat_count=1 per spec, so this gate only applies weekly.

Term-structure KINKED at back-month vs CONTANGO (spec multileg-strategist.md line 6, daily-analysis line 13): Anchors play_type classification (event vs vol-mispricing). Rationale: 'cannot distinguish calendar-earnings from calendar-vol-mispricing without term structure shape.' Derivable? `uw options-structure iv-term-structure` returns classification label (KINKED / CONTANGO / BACKWARDATION) but does NOT identify *which expiry* is kinked or provide expiry-specific IV levels. Agent must infer which expiry is the kink from the label + context — assumes KINKED always means 'binary event at a specific expiry' but tool does not disambiguate. **Rationale CITED but GATE REQUIRES MANUAL INFERENCE (classification is provided, but expiry-specific kink position is not).**

False-positive controls (spec multileg-strategist.md lines 27–31, daily-analysis): Skip if (a) dealer-hedge-shaped (mid-quote, low premium, high volume), (b) multileg contradicts underlying flow, (c) structure cannot be cleanly inferred, (d) weekly-only: repeat_count=1 AND no whale co-flag. (a) and (c) are subjective (no quantitative threshold for 'dealer-hedge-shaped' or 'cleanly inferred'). (b) requires comparison to single-leg accumulation/distribution signal (no CLI flag aggregates underlying flow vs options direction). **Rationale CITED but GATES ARE MOSTLY SUBJECTIVE / REQUIRE MANUAL ANALYST JUDGMENT.**

Rubric gate: +2 points only if 'directional structure (term-structure-anchored)' (daily-analysis Step 4, line 306): Requires multileg call to explicitly state term-structure context (KINKED / CONTANGO / BACKWARDATION) AND inferred play_type (event vs vol). Rationale from 2026-05-09 audit: 'multileg-vs-batch_strategy disagreements correctly resolved 5/5 in dataset' when term-structure is cited. Derivable? Agent can fetch iv-term-structure per ticker; structure classification is tool-provided. **Rationale CITED and GATE IS GATEABLE (requires agent to fetch tool + output both structure classification and play_type determination).**
multileg-strategist.scope_discipline:
**Boundary vs sweep-tracker:** Multileg owns *coordinated multi-strike/multi-expiry structures* (verticals, calendars, flies, condors, ratios); sweep-tracker owns *single-leg aggressive-directional flow*. A sweep that is part of a wider calendar is multileg's. Mutual-exclusivity rule (signal-confluence-quant.md C13): 'multileg × vol-surface (a calendar read by both): **multileg-flow > vol-structure** — if multileg-strategist named the structure, it owns the points.' **Multileg has explicit precedence.** Multileg does NOT score the *sweep persistence* (removed 2026-05-23 audit P0.3 as NO-INFO) — sweep is informational prose only. **Clear boundary: multileg owns structure identification; sweep owns single-leg persistence ranking.**

**Boundary vs vol-surface-scout:** Vol-surface owns *term-structure dislocations, IV outliers, and calendar-spread opportunities* — but multileg reads the SAME calendars and provides the *flow-derived structure inference*. C13 routing says: 'earnings-scout × vol-surface (KINKED earnings): **earnings-scout owns `earnings_vol`** for the KINKED-at-earnings case; vol-surface does not separately score.' This implies multileg does NOT double-score if vol-surface also flags the calendar — **multileg-flow wins if both agents cite the same structure.** Multileg is the *flow-reader*; vol-surface is the *price-structure reader*. **Boundary managed by C13 router in signal-confluence-quant.**

**Boundary vs earnings-scout:** Earnings-scout owns *pre-event IV term-structure* and BUY/SELL VOL verdicts; multileg owns *coordinated multi-leg institutional structures* that may be coincident with earnings. If multileg surfaces a calendar KINKED at an earnings expiry, both agents see the same structure, but multileg focuses on the *flow pattern* (who is buying which leg) and earnings-scout focuses on the *IV pricing decision* (is the front too cheap / too expensive). **No explicit conflict stated, but C13 implies multileg-flow defers to earnings-scout's BUY/SELL VOL verdict (earnings is the primary event context).** Actually, re-reading: earnings-scout surfaces KINKED-earnings calendars in its own right, and C13 says 'earnings-scout owns `earnings_vol`' — so if both flag a calendar at earnings, earnings-scout provides the trade decision (BUY/SELL VOL), and multileg provides the structure confirmation (vertical/calendar type and risk cap). **Both can cite the same name, but earnings-scout's BUY/SELL VOL verdict dominates.**

**Scope conclusion:** Multileg is clearly scoped to *structured multi-leg institutional flow inference*. Boundaries are well-documented via C13 router and precedence rules. No overlap drift detected."
multileg-strategist.scored_advisory_honesty:
**Scored lane:** +2 points if directional structure with term-structure context (daily-analysis Step 4, line 306). Audit trail from 2026-05-09 shows +8pp marginal contribution on n=5 backtest-score disagreement pairs. This is a *legitimate scored rubric line.* Agent outputs are properly routed through signal-confluence-quant.md where C13 enforces mutual exclusivity (multileg-flow > vol-structure, no double-counting). The +2 award is **not overstated** — agent is tasked to deliver term-structure-anchored structure only (i.e. mandatory term-structure context for scoring), which is explicitly checkable. **Scored prose is honest.**

**No advisory claimed in output fields.** The agent description states 'infer directional thesis with built-in risk caps' and the output template (spec lines 18–26) includes evidence, thesis, and invalidation — all are deterministic from the flow (structure type + term-structure + GEX positioning = thesis implications). **No confidence intervals or probabilistic language** — the call is either a vertical / calendar / fly etc. or it is not. **No probabilistic overreach detected.**

**False-positive controls (spec lines 27–31) include subjective gates** ('dealer-hedge-shaped', 'structure cannot be cleanly inferred') — these are *disqualification rules*, not scoring penalties, so they do not inflate confidence. Subjective disqualification is a *conservative gate, not an aggressive claim*. **Prose is calibrated to be conservative.**

**Single-day daily output (repeat_count = 1 by fiat) vs weekly (repeat_count ≥ 2 for HIGH):** Spec is honest that single-day structures are lower-conviction (repeat_count=1 contributes 0 weight to weekly conviction). Daily skill does not claim repeat_count weight; spec explicitly notes it is 'daily-skill use' on line 19. **No scored overreach via temporal arbitrage detected.**

**Overall:** Scored lane (+2) is modest, well-audited in prior backtest, and justified by term-structure anchor requirement. No advisory prose is conflated with scored claims. Disqualification gates are conservative. **Honesty level: HIGH.**"
multileg-strategist.write_rule_present:
**Watchlist write rule NOT present in agent definition.** The multileg-strategist.md file contains ZERO instructions to modify watchlists, write files, or mutate any state. The agent is tasked only to *read* tools and *output* per-ticker structure analysis (ticker, multileg_ratio, repeat_count, inferred_structure, term_structure_context, play_type, evidence, thesis, invalidation). **Output is consumed by signal-confluence-quant (Step 2a) and included in report prose §3/§7 — no agent-owned write.**

Multileg is spawned in Phase 1 (read-only parallel agents) and hands its findings to the quant, not to watchlist-manage. The orchestrator-level daily-analysis.md (Step 2d) specifies that `risk-monitor` (not multileg) calls `uw watchlist manage --action add … --tickers <top_5>` — **that write is risk-monitor's responsibility, not multileg's.**

**No watchlist-mutation risk present.**"
live_test_protocol: **Test 1: uw hot-chains multileg field mapping.** Run `uw hot-chains multileg --json --quiet --top-n 10` and inspect a sample row. Verify: (a) option_symbol is parseable (e.g., 'SPY260618P00720000' → ticker='SPY', strike=720, expiry=2026-06-18, type=PUT), (b) multileg_ratio field exists and is numeric, (c) premium field exists for size-filtering (spec requires ≥$1M). Confirm no per-ticker aggregation is present in raw output (contracts are returned individually). **Evidence:** option_symbol parse regex and multileg_ratio value should be directly readable.

**Test 2: multileg_ratio > 0.3 gate validity.** Run `uw hot-chains multileg --json --quiet` and histogram multileg_ratio values over the top 50 contracts today. Verify: (a) at least 5–10 contracts fall above 0.3 threshold (spec-stated entry gate is not vacuous), (b) distribution is non-uniform (0.3 is a meaningful discriminator, not just below-floor noise). **Evidence:** Percentile of 0.3 in live distribution; count of contracts above threshold.

**Test 3: greek-screener output structure for delta-skew inference.** Run `uw options-flow greek-screener --symbol SPY --json --quiet --top-n 20` and manually group by strike. Verify: (a) multiple contracts per strike exist (different expirations / sides), (b) delta values across a vertical (same expiry, different strikes) span a meaningful range (e.g., delta 0.2 to 0.8), (c) fly structure (e.g., short the ATM, long the wings) would show delta-neutral grouping if manually summed. **Evidence:** Confirm agent *can* group-by-strike and compute delta skew (no CLI-native skew stat is returned; agent must do the math).

**Test 4: expiry-heatmap STRIKE dimensionality gap.** Run `uw options-flow expiry-heatmap --symbol SPY --json --quiet --top-n 10`. Verify: (a) output has expiry, total_premium_call, total_premium_put, total_volume_call, total_volume_put (expiry aggregates only), (b) NO strike-level field is returned, (c) to identify a vertical (same expiry, two strikes) agent must cross-reference with greek-screener or raw multileg contracts. **Evidence:** Confirm heatmap output lacks strike field; agent must manually enrich with strike data from another tool.

**Test 5: iv-term-structure expiry-kink position.** Run `uw options-structure iv-term-structure --symbol SPY --json --quiet`. Verify: (a) classification field is present (BACKWARDATION | CONTANGO | KINKED), (b) NO per-expiry IV levels are returned (e.g., IV_front, IV_back, kink_expiry), (c) agent cannot mechanically determine which expiry is kinked without manual IV comparison. Spec says 'KINKED at <expiry>' (line 21) — but tool does not provide <expiry> coordinate. **Evidence:** Confirm classification label only; expiry-specific kink position requires agent inference.

**Test 6: Terminal structure-inference scenario.** Pick a ticker with live multileg_ratio > 0.3 from Test 1, and manually walk through the agent spec (lines 1–7) using actual tool outputs: (a) fetch uw hot-chains multileg for that ticker (multi-contract result), (b) fetch uw options-flow top-premium-trades --symbol <ticker> (largest single-legs), (c) fetch uw options-flow greek-screener --symbol <ticker> (delta profiles), (d) fetch uw options-flow expiry-heatmap --symbol <ticker> (expiry concentration), (e) fetch uw options-structure iv-term-structure --symbol <ticker> (classification), (f) fetch uw options-structure gex --symbol <ticker> (spread positioning). **Verify:** Agent can produce the spec output template (ticker, multileg_ratio, inferred_structure, term_structure_context, play_type, evidence, thesis, invalidation) from these six tool calls. If any field cannot be derived, flag it. **Evidence:** Completed spec-compliant output object for a live ticker.

**Test 7: False-positive gate: dealer-hedge-shaped.** Spec line 28 says 'skip if activity is dealer-hedge-shaped: mid-quote prints, low premium per contract, high volume.' Run uw options-flow top-premium-trades --symbol <multileg-candidate> --top-n 10 and inspect side field (ask | bid | no_side) and premium / size ratio. Verify: (a) mid-quote prints show side='no_side' (no agent field to flag mid-vs-edge, agent must infer from side field), (b) low-premium-per-contract is undefined (no threshold stated — is $10k low? $100k?), (c) high-volume is undefined. **Evidence:** Confirm gates (a) are partially tool-derivable, (b–c) require subjective agent judgment.

**Test 8: Flow-contradiction false-positive gate.** Spec line 29: 'multileg flow contradicts underlying flow direction (likely hedge, not alpha).' Run uw dark-pool ticker-summary and uw screener bullish-bearish for a multileg-candidate, and compare DP direction vs inferred multileg structure direction. Verify: (a) No CLI tool directly aggregates single-leg flow direction per underlying (agent must compare multileg.play_type = DIRECTIONAL_LONG vs DP inflow / outflow manually), (b) contradiction is subjective (−5% single-leg flow vs +2% multi-leg = contradiction? or noise?). **Evidence:** Confirm gate requires manual analyst cross-check (no mechanical tool output).

**Test 9: Scoring rubric gate — term-structure-anchored check.** Simulate signal-confluence-quant consuming a multileg output with raw structure (e.g., 'calendar, KINKED at 2026-06-18') and verify rubric line 306 applies +2 points. Confirm: (a) agent MUST include both inferred_structure AND term_structure_context fields in output, (b) if either is null/empty, scoring cannot proceed (no points awarded), (c) the audit trail must cite both source_agent='multileg-strategist' and which tools informed the structure (uw hot-chains multileg, uw options-structure iv-term-structure). **Evidence:** Trace a full score calculation where multileg contributes +2 and audit trail explicitly names multileg_strategist + tools.

static_findings.title: Tool output mismatch: uw hot-chains multileg returns CONTRACTS, not TICKERS; agent must parse option_symbol
static_findings.evidence: multileg-strategist.md line 8 directs agent to 'find tickers with multileg_ratio > 0.3', and daily-analysis.md line 209 lists 'uw hot-chains multileg — primary signal.' Tool output from `uw hot-chains multileg --json --quiet` returns {option_symbol, multileg_ratio, multileg_total, premium, …} with option_symbol values like 'SPY260618P00720000' (contract-level, not ticker). Agent spec line 18 requires ticker-level output ('per ticker, output: ticker, multileg_ratio, …'). **MISMATCH:** Tool returns contracts; agent must manually parse option_symbol and aggregate by ticker, then rank by multileg_ratio. Current spec does not explicitly document the parsing step or the aggregation logic (group-by-ticker, max/mean multileg_ratio per ticker?). This is a latent ambiguity in the agent mandate.

static_findings.title: iv-term-structure does not return expiry-specific kink position; spec requires 'KINKED at <expiry>'
static_findings.evidence: multileg-strategist.md line 21 requires output field 'term_structure_context — KINKED at <expiry> / BACKWARDATION / CONTANGO'. daily-analysis.md line 13 reiterates 'iv-term-structure — calendar inference. Calendar against KINKED at the back-month = event play; calendar against CONTANGO = vol-mispricing play. State which.' Tool: `uw options-structure iv-term-structure --symbol X --json` returns {classification: 'KINKED', …} with classification label only — NO per-expiry IV array and NO kink_expiry coordinate. Agent cannot mechanically populate 'KINKED at <expiry>' without manually inspecting IV levels or making assumptions (e.g., 'assume KINKED means the nearest expiry is kinked'). **UNRESOLVED:** Agent must infer expiry-specific kink location from classification label + context; spec assumes expiry is a derivable field.

static_findings.title: expiry-heatmap lacks STRIKE dimension; agent cannot natively distinguish vertical from diagonal without external enrichment
static_findings.evidence: multileg-strategist.md line 9 says 'uw options-flow expiry-heatmap — same expiry across two strikes = vertical; different expiries = calendar/diagonal'. Tool output from `uw options-flow expiry-heatmap --symbol SPY --json` returns {expiry, total_premium_call, total_premium_put, total_volume_call, total_volume_put}. **NO STRIKE FIELD.** To detect a vertical (same expiry, two active strikes), agent must cross-reference with greek-screener or raw multileg contracts to find which strikes are active *within* an expiry. **LATENT INEFFICIENCY:** Agent must make ≥2 tool calls per ticker (expiry-heatmap + greek-screener + most-active) to infer structure, but spec lists them sequentially as if heatmap directly answers the vertical/calendar question. Spec should clarify: 'use heatmap to identify expiry concentration, then cross-ref with greek-screener/most-active to find strike-level activity.'

static_findings.title: greek-screener returns individual contracts without native STRIKE-level delta-skew aggregation; agent must compute delta range/asymmetry manually
static_findings.evidence: multileg-strategist.md line 10 says 'uw options-flow greek-screener — delta skew across strikes confirms structure (vertical narrows delta range, fly is delta-neutral, ratio is asymmetric)'. Tool returns {strike, delta, gamma, vega, premium, side, …} per contract. **No aggregation by strike or skew computation.** Agent must manually (a) group contracts by strike, (b) compute delta range per strike-grouping, (c) infer structure type (narrow range → vertical, neutral sum → fly, asymmetric → ratio). This is a *deterministic agent task* (not ambiguous), but it is **not native to the tool** — the spec assumes the tool provides 'delta skew' as a readable field. **EFFICIENCY NOTE:** Agent can derive this with O(n) post-processing, so not a blocker; but it is underspecified in the agent mandate.

static_findings.title: top-premium-trades lacks native MULTILEG filter; agent must post-fetch filter for ≥$1M premium
static_findings.evidence: daily-analysis.md line 210 specifies 'uw options-flow top-premium-trades filtered to ≥$1M premium'. Tool CLI flags: --symbol, --option-type, --sector, --top-n. **NO --min-premium flag.** Agent must fetch top trades and filter client-side on premium ≥ 1M. Spec intends this tool to answer 'are large single-legs competing with the multileg book?' (line 11 says 'large single-legs against the multi-leg mean a hedge, not the thesis'). **MINOR INEFFICIENCY:** Agent could request higher --top-n and filter post-fetch, but the filtering logic is straightforward.

static_findings.title: False-positive control gates (spec lines 27–31) are subjective; no quantitative thresholds for 'dealer-hedge-shaped', 'cleanly inferred', 'contradicts underlying flow'
static_findings.evidence: multileg-strategist.md lines 27–31 list disqualification rules: (a) 'dealer-hedge-shaped: mid-quote prints, low premium per contract, high volume' — undefined thresholds for 'low' and 'high', (b) 'multileg flow contradicts underlying flow' — no tool aggregates single-leg flow per underlying, (c) 'structure cannot be cleanly inferred' — subjective analyst call. (d) weekly-only: 'repeat_count = 1 AND no aligned single-leg whale' — requires manual cross-check vs accumulation-hunter. **IMPACT:** These are *conservative disqualification gates*, so subjectivity errs on the side of false negatives (skip ambiguous structures), which is acceptable. However, the spec should document decision thresholds (e.g., 'mid-quote = >50% no_side prints', 'low premium per contract = <$10k median') to enable reproducible agent execution.

static_findings.title: repeat_count ≥2 (weekly mandate) requires multi-day state tracking not available from single CLI call; agent must cache or re-query prior days
static_findings.evidence: multileg-strategist.md line 16 says 'For weekly use, also evaluate multi-day repeat structure: identical strike/expiry combinations recurring on ≥2 trading days carry materially higher directional weight than single-day prints. Tag every output with a repeat_count (1–5) for the trailing week and require ≥2 for HIGH-conviction multileg calls.' **NO CLI FLAG** in uw hot-chains multileg for --lookback-days or --repeat-count. Agent must: (a) query uw hot-chains multileg for TODAY, (b) query for each of the last N trading days (4–5 days), (c) manually cross-match strike/expiry combinations across days, (d) compute repeat_count per structure. **OPERATIONAL BURDEN:** Weekly skill must persist multi-day state or re-run 5 queries per ticker. The daily skill side-steps this by spec-fiat (line 19: repeat_count=1 for daily), so daily is unaffected. **Weekly agent must implement state caching or accept higher API cost.**

static_findings.title: Rubric scoring precedence vs vol-surface-scout not explicit in agent spec; C13 router lives in signal-confluence-quant, not multileg-strategist
static_findings.evidence: multileg-strategist.md does NOT mention vol-surface-scout or earnings-scout or any precedence rule. signal-confluence-quant.md C13 documents: 'multileg × vol-surface (a calendar read by both): **multileg-flow > vol-structure** — if multileg-strategist named the structure, it owns the points; vol-surface is context, not a second scored line.' **DESIGN CLARITY:** The multileg agent is unaware of the precedence rule; the rule is enforced only at the quant layer. If multileg surfaced a calendar but vol-surface also flagged it, the router awards points to multileg. Agent should document this interaction (even if non-actionable) for completeness, or it should be left to quant (current design). **NO RISK:** The router is properly implemented in signal-confluence-quant; multileg's mandate does not need to mention it. This is a **documentation / scope-boundary clarity issue, not a functional bug.**

static_findings.title: Audit trail requirement for term-structure-anchored +2 score not documented in agent spec; signal-confluence-quant.md line 175 shows requirement post-hoc
static_findings.evidence: multileg-strategist.md output spec (lines 18–26) includes 'evidence' and 'thesis' but does NOT explicitly state 'include term_structure_context in output or scoring is impossible.' daily-analysis.md Step 4 line 306 states '+2 multileg-strategist with directional structure (term-structure-anchored play type).' signal-confluence-quant.md line 175 shows example: '{"rubric_line": "+2 multileg-strategist directional structure (term-structure-anchored)", "points": 2, "source_agent": "multileg-strategist", "source_tool": "uw hot-chains multileg", …}' with implicit assumption that multileg has provided term_structure_context. **SPEC CLARITY:** multileg-strategist.md should explicitly state: 'MANDATORY for scoring: your output MUST include term_structure_context (e.g., KINKED at 2026-06-18, CONTANGO) or the +2 rubric points cannot be awarded.' Current spec implies this via line 22 but does not flag it as scoring-blocking.

static_findings.title: No specification of how to handle ties or edge cases in structure inference (e.g., ambiguous vertical vs. diagonal, ratio interpretation)
static_findings.evidence: multileg-strategist.md lines 20 lists inferred structures as 'vertical / calendar / fly / condor / ratio / diagonal' but provides no decision tree for ambiguous cases. For example: (a) same expiry, three strikes (is this a fly + single-leg hedge? a ratio?), (b) two expirations but not cleanly spaced (calendar vs. diagonal?), (c) call-heavy ratio vs put-heavy ratio (which is BULLISH vs BEARISH?). False-positive control line 30 says 'structure cannot be cleanly inferred from the strikes/expiries hit' — but spec does not define 'cleanly.' **IMPACT:** Agent judgment call. This is acceptable (analyst discretion is expected for edge cases), but spec could provide decision thresholds (e.g., 'ratio = bid/ask size asymmetry ≥3:1', 'fly = three strikes with center long, wings short') to reduce ambiguity.

sweep-tracker.job_clarity: Agent "sweep-tracker" is scoped to identify aggressive options sweeps and smart money flow for short-term directional momentum trades. Primary mandate: surface multi-day persistent sweep behaviour (≥3 of 5 days same direction) as the sole first-class edge; single-day sweeps are narrative-only (zero scoring contribution post-2026-05-23 P0.3 audit). Output: urgency-ranked sweep ledger by persistence count, premium size, expiry, with explicit `opening_confirmed` flag (OI-trend BUILDING or ΔOI ≥20% of day volume) and mega-cap hedge-flow filter (for SPY/QQQ/IWM/SPXW + top-10 mega-caps: sweep-persistence direction must align with cum_flow_30d direction or demoted to watch-only). Citation discipline enforced: cum_flow_30d is alignment-screen-only (NOT standalone directional confirmation); dividend-capture arb calls (deep-ITM sub-parity ex-div calls) are filtered out as noise.
tool_wiring: uw hot-chains sweep-persistence [--symbol] [--days 5] [--top-n 20]: VERIFIED — returns {ticker, sessions_in_top, consistency_score, dominant_direction, total_sweep_premium, dates_covered}. Persistence count is 'sessions_in_top' field (0–5 for 5-day window).

uw hot-chains sweep-ratio [--date] [--min-sweep-ratio 0.3] [--min-volume 500] [--top-n 20]: VERIFIED — returns {ticker, sweep_volume, volume, sweep_ratio, expiry, strike, premium}. 'sweep_volume/volume' ratio is the wiring point.

uw hot-chains smart-money-flow [--date] [--direction bullish|bearish] [--min-volume 500] [--top-n 20]: VERIFIED — returns {option_symbol, ask_bid_ratio, ask_side_volume, bid_side_volume, net_flow, premium, volume}. ask/bid imbalance fields: ask_side_volume, bid_side_volume, ask_bid_ratio.
uw hot-chains most-active [--date] [--sort-by volume|premium|trades] [--top-n 20]: VERIFIED — returns {underlying, strike, expiry, volume, premium, trades}. Per-strike activity context.

uw options-flow sweeps [--date] [--side ask|bid] [--symbol] [--min-premium 100000] [--top-n 20]: VERIFIED — returns {underlying_symbol, strike, expiry, option_type, side, total_premium, total_size, trade_count}. Single-day sweep tape for comparison vs persistence rank.
uw options-flow top-premium-trades [--date] [--symbol] [--option-type call|put] [--top-n 20]: VERIFIED — returns contract-level whale trades. Premium and size context.
uw screener volume-vs-average [--date] [--min-volume-ratio 2] [--top-n 20]: VERIFIED — returns {ticker, volume_vs_avg, current_volume, avg_volume}. Underlying volume confirmation.

uw historical cumulative-premium-flow [--symbol] [--days 30|90]: VERIFIED — returns {symbol, net_flow, cumulative_bullish, cumulative_bearish, trend_direction, dates_covered}. Alignment screen for mega-cap filter: `net_flow` sign vs sweep direction; `|net_flow|` vs $50M floor.
uw historical oi-trend [--symbol] [--days 5]: VERIFIED — returns per-day OI state. Must read state (BUILDING vs FALLING/FLAT) to confirm opening-flow vs churn (Pan-Poteshman C4 gate).
uw oi biggest-increases [--symbol] [--min-dte 180|0] [--max-dte 30] [--top-n 20]: VERIFIED — returns {ticker, oi_change}. Δ OI for opening-gate computation (≥20% of day volume threshold).
uw oi decrease-with-volume [--symbol] [--min-volume 100] [--top-n 20]: VERIFIED — returns {option_symbol, oi_decrease, volume}. Identifies closing/distribution flow.
gates_assessment: Gate 1 — Persistence threshold (≥3 of 5 days): CITED, DERIVABLE. sweep-persistence returns 'sessions_in_top' directly. Threshold of 3 is hardcoded in the agent spec (line 19: 'Persistent across ≥3 of 5 sessions').

Gate 2 — Mega-cap hedge-flow filter: CITED, DERIVABLE but INCOMPLETE. Agent spec (line 31) names the list: SPY, QQQ, IWM, SPXW + top-10 US mega-caps by market cap. However, the 'top-10 by market cap' subset is NOT recomputed in each run — it is a static list 'typically AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL/GOOG, AMZN, META, TSLA, BRK.B, AVGO, JPM'. There is no `uw` subcommand to enumerate current top-10 mega-caps by market cap; the agent must hard-code or fetch externally (e.g., yfinance `get_institutional_holders` or finviz). No citation of which data source or refresh frequency. RISK: the list can drift (e.g., Nvidia falling out, Tesla rising in — neither happened recently, but the spec does not clarify who maintains it).

Gate 3 — Cum_flow_30d alignment (mega-cap only): CITED, DERIVABLE. cumulative-premium-flow returns {net_flow, cumulative_bullish, cumulative_bearish, trend_direction}. Direction alignment = sign(net_flow) == sign(sweep_direction). Magnitude floor $50M is hardcoded (line 31 and signal-confluence-quant.md C11).

Gate 4 — OI-confirmed-opening (all names): CITED, DERIVABLE. uw historical oi-trend returns per-day state (BUILDING vs others). ΔOI ≥ 20% of day volume threshold is hardcoded but requires manual computation: Δ OI from oi-biggest-increases or subtract today minus yesterday; day volume from options-flow sweeps or hot-chains. No single-call ΔOI ratio output — agent must compute.

Gate 5 — Distribution flag (bullish-side OI closing): CITED, NOT DIRECTLY GATEABLE. uu oi decrease-with-volume returns closing contracts, but the agent must manually check whether the closing is on the bullish side of a long thesis (cross-ref with strike and option_type). No atomic 'distribution_flag' output from the CLI.

Gate 6 — Dividend-capture arb filter (ex-div names): CITED, DERIVABLE with external data. Spec (line 31, P1.4) filters 'deep-ITM sub-parity call sweeps near ex-div'. The CLI returns prices (via gex tool) and IV, but does not return ex-dividend dates; agent must fetch from yahoo-finance MCP or external calendar. Not gateable from CLI output alone.

DERIVED NUMERIC GATES: All thresholds (≥3 of 5, $50M cum_flow, 20% ΔOI, ask/bid ratio extremes) are either hardcoded in the spec or deterministic from tool output. No machine-learning or adaptive thresholds.
sweep-tracker.scope_discipline: Overlap vectors: (1) **sweep-tracker vs multileg-strategist**: both surface directional flow structures. Fence: sweep-tracker owns persistence-ranked single-day sweeps (narrative, 0 scoring post-P0.3); multileg owns coordinated multi-leg structures (trade-level) and gets the score if present. (2) **sweep-tracker vs accumulation-hunter**: both surface directional conviction. Fence: accumulation-hunter owns dark-pool block-stratified + OI-smart-positioning (3-signal conjunction, potential +3 scoring); sweep-tracker owns options-tape urgency (sweeps). A name can carry both tags without double-scoring (multileg or accumulation gets points, sweeps are narrative). (3) **sweep-tracker vs contrarian-scanner**: a crowded long can also be sweeping bullish. Fence (signal-confluence-quant.md C13): contrarian acknowledges the sweep contradiction in prose, applies the crowded-fade penalty OR the flow read, never both. No double-deduction. (4) **sweep-tracker vs uw historical cumulative-premium-flow**: the agent uses cum_flow_30d as an alignment-gate only (for mega-cap filter), never as standalone directional confirmation (signal-confluence-quant.md P1.4, P1.5 lines). This boundary is **cited and enforced in the rubric** — violation is an agent bug (misused as `+1 cumulative-premium-flow` line when it should be 0)."
sweep-tracker.scored_advisory_honesty: Agent mandates swept outcomes: (1) **Primary output is narrative, not scored**: "sweep-tracker still surfaces persistence-ranked sweeps in §3/§7 prose, but those names earn no points unless a multileg or accumulation co-flag is present." (sweep-tracker.md line 302, and signal-confluence-quant.md line 97). This is unambiguous — sweeps alone contribute 0 points; the agent prose is purely informational, feeding §2/§3/§7 of the daily report. (2) **OI-confirmed-opening is a routing flag, not a score gate**: "a sweep that is OI-confirmed-opening AND co-flagged by accumulation-hunter or multileg-strategist is a genuine opening build the quant can score through those tools (the sweep itself still earns 0 points)" (sweep-tracker.md line 33). The C4 gate (signal-confluence-quant.md line 66–69) caps `pre_risk_size` at half when opening is unconfirmed, but only for `bullish_flow` / `bearish_flow` classes — NOT for sweep-tracker candidacy. (3) **Mega-cap hedge-flow filter is ranking discipline, not scoring**: "the ranking discipline [is] kept because the agent's narrative output still feeds §2/§3/§7 of the report" (sweep-tracker.md line 31; emphasis added). The filter does not affect `raw_score`, only narrative ordering. No citation of inflated confidence is present — the agent correctly states this is an output-ordering rule to separate 'hedge flow' from 'directional.' (4) **Dividend-capture arb filter**: cites a specific example (NEE 2026-06-04 false-bullish) with explicit rationale (P1.4 audit). No overconfidence on sub-parity call sweeps — correctly frames them as 'arb, not conviction.'"
sweep-tracker.write_rule_present: Yes. Agent is read-only. Mandate states: "Output ranked by persistence count first, premium size second, with: ticker, direction, persistence count (N of 5), expiry targeted, cumulative premium, a one-line read on what the flow implies, and an explicit invalidation." No write or watchlist-mutation operations are assigned to sweep-tracker; all watchlist write-back is owned by `risk-monitor` (daily-analysis.md Step 2d, line 264). Agent must **not** invoke `uw watchlist manage` — this is a critical **read-only audit**, and sweep-tracker has no write mandate."
live_test_protocol: TEST 1 — Persistence count verification: Run `uw hot-chains sweep-persistence --json --quiet` and confirm the top-5 entries. Each must have a `sessions_in_top` field (integer 0–5). Verify at least 3 names exist with `sessions_in_top >= 3` (the agent's stated minimum for first-class signal). PASS/FAIL CRITERION: ≥3 names with sessions_in_top >= 3 exist in the result set; if fewer, the sweep-tracker narrative is entitled to surface only a stub (no first-class candidates) in §3.

TEST 2 — Single-day vs persistent divergence: Run `uw options-flow sweeps --json --quiet --top-n 10` and `uw hot-chains sweep-persistence --json --quiet` side-by-side. Extract the union of tickers from both. For each ticker, note: (a) whether it appears in the top-10 single-day sweeps; (b) whether it has `sessions_in_top >= 3` in persistence. Verify the sets DO NOT perfectly overlap. PASS/FAIL CRITERION: if single-day top-10 and persistence top-5 are identical (≥8-of-10 overlap), the agent's claim that 'persistence is the edge, not size' is contradicted by today's tape. (Historical precedent: 2026-05-19 tape showed NVDA/SPY/AAPL dominate both lists, but mid-cap names like HRMN appear in single-day only — divergence confirmed.)

TEST 3 — Ask/bid imbalance fields: Run `uw hot-chains smart-money-flow --json --quiet` and extract the first 5 records. For each, verify the presence of: `ask_side_volume`, `bid_side_volume`, `ask_bid_ratio`, `net_flow`. PASS/FAIL CRITERION: all four fields present in every record. Spot-check one record: compute `ask_bid_ratio` manually from ask/bid volumes to confirm the field's accuracy (field value should roughly match ask_side_volume / bid_side_volume, or its inverse for bid-side dominance).

TEST 4 — Mega-cap hedge-flow filter computability: Manually run the filter for one test name in the named mega-cap subset (e.g., NVDA or SPY). (a) Run `uw hot-chains sweep-persistence --symbol NVDA --json --quiet`; note the `dominant_direction` (bullish/bearish/mixed). (b) Run `uw historical cumulative-premium-flow --symbol NVDA --days 30 --json --quiet`; note the `net_flow` sign (positive = bullish, negative = bearish) and magnitude in dollars. (c) Check alignment: does sign(net_flow) match the sweep direction from (a)? Is |net_flow| >= $50M? PASS/FAIL CRITERION: the filter is computable from these two calls. If either call fails or returns null fields, the gate is NOT gateable. Record the result: e.g., 'NVDA: sweeps=bearish, cum_flow_30d=+$15.2B bullish, UNALIGNED → demote to hedge-flow watch' or 'AAPL: sweeps=mixed, cum_flow_30d=+$82.8M bullish, ALIGNED ✓ → no demotion'.

TEST 5 — OI-opening confirmation reproducibility: For a persistent sweep name (from TEST 1), run (a) `uw historical oi-trend --symbol <TICKER> --days 5 --json --quiet` and check the state field (should be BUILDING, FALLING, FLAT, or ROLLING_OFF). (b) Run `uw oi biggest-increases --symbol <TICKER> --json --quiet` and extract today's ΔOI from the result. (c) Run `uw options-flow sweeps --symbol <TICKER> --json --quiet` and estimate today's total volume. (d) Compute manually: is ΔOI >= 20% of day volume? PASS/FAIL CRITERION: the C4 gate is computable from these two/three tools. If oi-trend returns BUILDING or ΔOI meets threshold, tag `opening_confirmed: true`. If FALLING/FLAT and ΔOI < 20% of volume, tag `opening_confirmed: false`. The agent's spec (line 33) requires this tag on every surfaced name.

TEST 6 — Co-flag routing (accumulation or multileg): For the top persistence name from TEST 1, verify whether the same ticker appears in (a) accumulation-hunter's output (dark-pool block-stratified ≥ 3 signals aligned) OR (b) multileg-strategist's output (uw hot-chains multileg flagged). If either is true, the sweep is NOT solo and earns score potential through the co-flag tool. PASS/FAIL CRITERION: at least one sweep-tracker candidate (non-mega-cap) carries a co-flag; if none do, verify the report correctly notes them as narrative-only (0 scoring) per P0.3. This tests the gating discipline—that sweeps-alone do not score.

static_findings.title: Job clarity: sweep-tracker narrative contribution vs scoring is unambiguous post-P0.3
static_findings.evidence: Agent spec line 6: 'Persistence is the edge, not size. Real desks discount single-day sweeps as ~50% news-event noise.' Lines 8–24: detailed output format and ranking discipline. Lines 300–302 in daily-analysis.md: '# +1 line for uw hot-chains sweep-persistence top-5 REMOVED 2026-05-23 audit P0.3. Reason: marginal contribution −22pp two consecutive audits (n=15); mega-cap suppression rule from 2026-05-15 P1.1 was insufficient. Tool remains informational — sweep-tracker still surfaces persistence-ranked sweeps in §3/§7 prose — but contributes 0 points to raw_score.' Signal-confluence-quant.md line 97: 'Sweep persistence is now informational only: sweep-tracker still surfaces persistence-ranked names in §2/§3/§7 prose, but those names earn no points unless a multileg or accumulation co-flag is present (those tools then earn the score in their own right).'

static_findings.title: Mega-cap hedge-flow filter list is static, not dynamically enumerable
static_findings.evidence: Agent spec line 31 defines the filter scope: 'For the named index / mega-cap subset — SPY, QQQ, IWM, SPXW, and the top-10 US mega-caps by market cap (typically AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL/GOOG, AMZN, META, TSLA, BRK.B, AVGO, JPM)'. The word 'typically' signals a static list. There is NO uw subcommand to fetch current top-10 mega-caps by market cap (e.g., no `uw screener market-cap-decile`). The agent must either (a) hard-code the list in its prompt, or (b) fetch from yfinance MCP or finviz-pp-cli. No citation of data source or refresh schedule. RISK: the list can drift over months/years (e.g., if ARM, CrowdStrike, or other mega-caps emerge). RECOMMENDATION: add a maintenance note to sweep-tracker.md documenting the list's refresh cadence (e.g., 'reviewed quarterly' or 'auto-fetch from yfinance market-cap rank').

static_findings.title: OI-opening gate (C4) requires manual ΔOI computation; no atomic tool output
static_findings.evidence: Sweep-tracker.md line 33 specifies: 'Read it from the aggregate OI: uw historical oi-trend BUILDING in the sweep direction, or ΔOI (uw oi biggest-increases / uw oi decrease-with-volume) ≥ ~20% of the day's contract volume → opening-dominant; flat / falling OI against high volume → closing / day-trade churn.' The tools exist (verified above), but there is no atomic 'ΔOI-ratio' output. Agent must: (1) Read today's ΔOI from oi-biggest-increases; (2) estimate day volume from options-flow sweeps aggregation; (3) compute ratio manually as ΔOI / (volume × avg_price) or ΔOI / volume-count depending on the tool's output format. High cognitive load and error-prone if volumes are not directly comparable (options reported in contracts, oi in contracts; need underlying price context for magnitude check). WORKAROUND: the agent can also rely on uw historical oi-trend's BUILDING state as the primary signal (no manual computation needed); the 20% floor is a secondary confirmation gate.

static_findings.title: Distribution flag (C28) requires cross-referencing with strike/option type; not atomic
static_findings.evidence: Sweep-tracker.md line 33 mentions 'distribution_flag' as a byproduct of accumulation-hunter (C28 gate in signal-confluence-quant.md line 171): '... each with an advisory `distribution_flag` (the C28 direct-flow distribution check)'. signal-confluence-quant.md line 171 documents: 'uw oi decrease-with-volume (`--min-volume 500`) — **distribution counter-signal (C28)**: bullish-side OI being *closed* on high volume on a long-thesis name = accumulation-as-distribution tell.' uw oi decrease-with-volume returns contracts being closed, but does NOT label them as 'bullish-side' or 'bearish-side' — the agent must parse the option_symbol to extract the strike and option_type, then determine the side based on the underlying price and thesis direction. Accumulation-hunter owns this logic, not sweep-tracker. IMPLICATION: sweep-tracker does not independently compute the distribution_flag; it receives the flag from the quant's output if the name was co-flagged by accumulation-hunter.

static_findings.title: Dividend-capture arb filtering (deep-ITM sub-parity ex-div calls) requires external calendar
static_findings.evidence: Sweep-tracker.md line 31 (P1.4): 'on dividend payers near ex-div, deep-ITM sub-parity call sweeps are dividend-capture arb, not conviction (the NEE 2026-06-04 false-bullish).' The uw CLI does not return ex-dividend dates or mark dividend-payer status. Agent must: (1) fetch from yfinance MCP (available in the repo) or external finviz API, or (2) maintain a hard-coded dividend calendar. NEE example (2026-06-04) is cited, implying the agent has this context available. No explicit tool invocation documented; the gate is manual (prose-only documentation). IMPLICATION: if the agent encounters deep-ITM sub-parity calls on a dividend payer near ex-div, it must manually filter them with a note. This is not gateable from uw output alone.

static_findings.title: Sweep-persistence rubric line removed entirely; sweep-tracker output is narrative-only
static_findings.evidence: Daily-analysis.md Step 4, lines 300–303: '# +1 line for uw hot-chains sweep-persistence top-5 REMOVED 2026-05-23 audit P0.3 ... Tool remains informational — sweep-tracker still surfaces persistence-ranked sweeps in §3/§7 prose — but contributes 0 points to raw_score. If the call merits a multileg or accumulation co-flag, those tools earn the score instead.' Signal-confluence-quant.md line 97: identical statement. This is a DELIBERATE design choice after two consecutive audits found the tool NEGATIVE (−22pp marginal, n=15). The agent continues to surface sweeps because they 'remain the most useful momentum cue' (agent spec line 8) but without scoring credit. No inflation of confidence is present.
